## mana

Pay mana as part of an activation. Paid during the activation by spending mana from your pool, tapping sources one at a time.

Rules: CR 601.2g, CR 601.2h, CR 602.2b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | mana cost string, e.g. "{1}{R}" |

```json
{
  "mana": "{1}{R}"
}
```

## tap

{T} — tap the permanent the ability belongs to. Requires it to be untapped.

Rules: CR 107.5, CR 602.5a

```json
"tap"
```
